subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Can maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate coverage as proof for this non-inducible xAI stale encrypted_content error, or should merge wait for an organic after-fix Grok/gateway capture?
rationale: The external-PR proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the author plausibly explains that xAI's code-less decrypt failure depends on provider-side key or snapshot rotation and cannot be forced on demand without exercising a different coded error path.

options.title: Accept proof override for this narrow matcher
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix logs, focused predicate tests, and already-proven one-shot retry machinery as enough to merge after exact-head CI and maintainer review.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix capture
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real provider rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Pause for broader retry work
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers prefer to resolve xAI through the larger encrypted-content recovery design instead of this narrow pre-stream predicate fix.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override for this narrow matcher
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix logs, focused predicate tests, and already-proven one-shot retry machinery as enough to merge after exact-head CI and maintainer review.
